name: Slingshot
description:
Connect Claude to your Slingshot workspace to plan, track, and update work in natural language. Slingshot is a work-management platform that brings tasks, projects, discussions, dashboards, and data together in one place.

The connector exposes nearly 70 tools across Slingshot's core surface:

- Workspaces & projects — create, read, update, delete, and manage members and roles
- Tasks — create, update, delete, list, view "my tasks," post messages, and log time
- Task lists, sections & task types — structure and categorize work
- Custom fields — define and manage structured task metadata
- Discussions — open threads and post messages
- Dashboards & data sources — read dashboards and query connected data
- Profile & membership — read your profile and workspace/project members

Reads and writes are separate tools, and every tool carries read-only or destructive hints so Claude confirms before anything irreversible, such as deleting a task or workspace.

Authentication uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. You sign in with your existing Slingshot account, and the connector acts only with your own permissions.

For safety, some capabilities are intentionally excluded: webhook management and file upload/download are not exposed, which prevents prompt-injection and unsafe binary transfer paths.

Requires a Slingshot account. Learn more at slingshotapp.io.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Slingshot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Slingshot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.slingshotapp.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Slingshot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slingshot lists 67 MCP tools, including slingshot_add_project_member, slingshot_add_time_log, slingshot_add_workspace_member, slingshot_check_service_status, slingshot_create_custom_field, slingshot_create_dashboard, slingshot_create_discussion, slingshot_create_project, slingshot_create_task, slingshot_create_task_list, slingshot_create_task_section, and slingshot_create_task_type.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Slingshot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Slingshot in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Slingshot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Slingshot is developed by Slingshot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
